toolResult.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
toolResult.abstract: We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize.

toolResult.title: Attention Is All You Need
toolResult.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

toolResult.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
toolResult.abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text.

toolResult.title: Generative Adversarial Networks
toolResult.abstract: We propose a new framework for estimating generative models via an adversarial process, in which we simultaneously train two models: a generative model G that captures the data distribution, and a discriminative model D.

toolResult.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners

toolResult.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models

toolResult.abstract: We show that diffusion models can achieve image sample quality superior to the current state-of-the-art generative models. We achieve this on unconditional image synthesis by finding a better architecture through a series of ablations.

toolResult.abstract: We provide a comprehensive survey of knowledge graph embedding methods, covering translation-based models (TransE, TransH), semantic matching models (RESCAL, DistMult), and deep learning-based approaches.

toolResult.title: DALL·E 2: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
toolResult.abstract: We present a two-stage approach to text-to-image generation. DALL·E 2 uses CLIP to map text descriptions to image embeddings and a diffusion model to decode those embeddings into highly realistic images.

toolResult.title: Neural Architecture Search with Reinforcement Learning

toolResult.title: MobileNetV3: Searching for MobileNetV3

toolResult.title: Federated Learning: Challenges, Methods, and Future Directions

toolResult.abstract: We introduce Mixtral 8x7B, a sparse mixture of experts language model. Mixtral has the same architecture as Mistral 7B, with the feedforward blocks replaced by a mixture-of-experts layer, outperforming GPT-3.5 on most benchmarks.

toolResult.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
toolResult.abstract: As AI systems become more capable, we need to train them to be both helpful and safe. We present Constitutional AI, a method for training harmless AI assistants using a set of principles.

toolResult.abstract: We introduce Flamingo, a family of Visual Language Models (VLM) with a few-shot learning capability. Flamingo bridges powerful pre-trained vision-only and language-only models, handling sequences of arbitrarily interleaved visual and textual data.

toolResult.title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

toolResult.abstract: We present TFT, a novel attention-based architecture combining high-performance multi-horizon forecasting with interpretable insights into temporal dynamics. TFT uses variable selection networks and multi-head attention.

toolResult.abstract: We survey recent advances in applying large foundation models — including LLMs, vision-language models, and diffusion models — to robotics tasks such as manipulation, navigation, and task planning.

toolResult.title: Data-Efficient Image Recognition with Contrastive Predictive Coding
toolResult.abstract: We propose contrastive predictive coding (CPC) for unsupervised feature learning. CPC uses a contrastive loss to learn representations that predict future observations in latent space.

toolResult.abstract: We review the history of neurosymbolic AI from early hybrid systems to modern neural-symbolic integration. We discuss current approaches that combine neural perception with symbolic reasoning and highlight open challenges.

toolResult.title: Large-Scale Study of Curiosity-Driven Learning
toolResult.abstract: We perform a large-scale empirical study of curiosity as an intrinsic reward signal for reinforcement learning. We test curiosity across 54 environments and find it leads to consistent improvements in exploration.

toolResult.title: Robustness and Reliability in Machine Learning Systems
toolResult.abstract: We survey current approaches to building reliable machine learning systems, covering distribution shift, adversarial robustness, uncertainty estimation, and out-of-distribution detection.

toolResult.title: Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses in LLM-Integrated Applications
toolResult.abstract: We systematically investigate prompt injection attacks in LLM-integrated applications. We define threat models, catalog attack types, and evaluate defenses. Our study shows current defenses are insufficient against adaptive attacks.

toolResult.title: Not All Tokens Are What You Need
toolResult.abstract: We find that during language model pre-training, tokens corresponding to semantically rich content contribute disproportionately to learning. We propose selective token training to improve efficiency without degrading quality.
